verdicts.reason: A is just the portrait original shrunk into the middle of a wide banner: the photo, yellow headline block and gold frame line take up roughly a third of the width, leaving huge dead white areas on both sides, and the small 'LOVE. CARE. KIDS.' text is weak at this size. Nothing was rearranged, but at least the composition holds together. B has the same shrunk, centred layout and the same empty sides, and it also scatters fragments: the yellow dash rules sit stranded in the empty left area, and the top yellow bar has jumped to the top-right corner. That breaks the grouping and makes it look clearly broken.
